Working notes: order intake validation
- Form v1 required fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Validate all six before accepting.
- Batch IDs increment from ORD-5100. Each batch gets up to 3 attempts. After a 3rd rejection, stop and send to manual review.
- Most failures cite invalid/missing priority, qty, ship_country. Focus corrections there first, then revalidate all fields.
- Evidence: Eli Reyes ORD-5100 rejected for priority+ship_country, then ORD-5101 accepted. Bo Sato ORD-5108 rejected for priority+ship_country, then ORD-5109 accepted.
- Ada Sato and Dee Reyes stayed invalid on priority/qty/ship_country across attempts and were not accepted.
- Source labels ("voicemail", "phone order", "handwritten", "partner portal", "duplicate check already done") do not prove field validity. Validate anyway.
- Truncated JSON in logs may omit trailing valid fields; do not infer missing data from truncation alone.
- On retry: correct priority, qty, and ship_country; preserve cust/email/order_date unless evidence contradicts.

Working notes: order intake validation
- Required fields for form v1 and v2: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Validate all six before accepting.
- Batch IDs increment from ORD-5100. Each intake record gets up to 3 attempts; attempts appear as consecutive batch IDs. After a 3rd rejection, stop and send to manual review.
- Rejections usually cite priority and/or ship_country; qty was seen earlier. Correct priority/ship_country first, then qty, then revalidate all six.
- New evidence: Ada Sato ORD-5110/5111, Cy Marsh ORD-5112/5113, and Eli Reyes ORD-5117/5118 were rejected then accepted on retry. Bo Reyes ORD-5114–5116 failed 3 attempts (priority; priority+ship_country) and went to manual review. ORD-5119 rejected priority.
- Source labels ("partner portal", "duplicate check already done", "customer confirmation", "handwritten/voicemail transcription", "ordinary priority") do not prove field validity. Validate anyway.
- Truncated JSON logs may omit trailing valid fields; do not infer missing data from truncation alone.
- On retry: correct priority, qty, ship_country; preserve cust/email/order_date unless evidence contradicts.
- Form v2 still lists the same six required fields; version alone does not change validation.
